title: Lunar Combustion Investigation: Flammability Results
locator: LUCI: SIBAL fabric and SIBAL Flame Spread Fit Comparison
finding: NASA reports a flame-base spread rate of 0.92 mm/s for the downward-burning SIBAL cotton-fiberglass specimen in simulated lunar gravity. The 1-g comparison reports 1.5 mm/s from a linear fit.
limits: Simulated lunar acceleration in a rotating chamber is a specific test environment. SIBAL differs from plain cotton. The indexed rows do not contain numeric pressure, imposed airflow, starting oxygen or uncertainty.
terms: lunar moon partial gravity earth cotton fabric flammability comparison SIBAL spread habitat

title: Results of Large-Scale Spacecraft Flammability Tests
finding: The wide SIBAL cotton-fiberglass sample had mean flame spread rates of 1.8 mm/s with concurrent flow and 1.3 mm/s with opposed flow. The narrower Saffire-II specimen spread at 2.1 mm/s at the same nominal flow speed.
limits: Direction, width and starting oxygen differ. These observations do not isolate any one factor.
terms: solid material flammability forced airflow cotton lunar oxygen flame spread

title: Experimental Observations of Methanol Droplet Combustion and Extinction
finding: The report describes methanol droplet extinction in quiescent microgravity in oxygen, carbon dioxide and nitrogen mixtures at two total pressures.
limits: Droplet findings have limited applicability to solid fuels and ventilated habitats.
terms: suppression co2 carbon dioxide dilution extinction pressure liquid inert

title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment – Reflight
finding: NASA identifies SAME-R as an ISS spacecraft fire safety investigation in combustion science.
limits: The reflight catalog entry supplies investigation context. Detector performance is outside this evidence card.

title: NASA Glenn Combustion Science
finding: NASA describes BASS as examining burning and extinction of solids, DAFT as checking the operation of a modified particle counter, and FLEX as studying inert-gas suppression of droplet flames.
limits: Program summaries describe objectives and apparatus at the investigation level.
terms: bass solid extinction daft instrument detection flex flammability
